description: For a job the app marks as applied on the employer's own site (apply_to_public_job / start_apply_run answer that they do not apply there for the person): tailors the person's CV and writes the cover letter for that one job, on request, using no application credit. Returns the cover letter text; fetch the two PDFs with get_external_pack_pdf. A paid model call, cached per job. Nothing is sent to the employer.

job_id.description: A job_id from list_matching_jobs or from apply_to_public_job.

name: prepare_external_application
title: Write the CV and cover letter for a job we do not apply to
